name: CommuteAssistFindPharmacy

custom.system_prompt: You are generating a short scene where a person needs to find a pharmacy while commuting or running errands. They ask Sigma, get a nearby option, and get directions. Keep it brief.

sound_effects_config.prompt: City street, urban foot traffic, outdoor shopping area, daytime city sounds

initial_prompt: Generate a short scene where a person needs a pharmacy. They're on foot in the city. They ask Sigma for the nearest pharmacy, possibly adding that they need it to be open. Sigma gives the closest option with directions. One possible follow-up if they're not sure about opening hours. Keep exchanges very short.

user1.name: Sofia
user1.tts_prompt: Practical, on foot, a bit hurried

variations.context: Finding a pharmacy while on the move in the city

setting.relationship_dynamic: Solo person with an errand to run
setting.background: Needs to pick something up from a pharmacy — headache tablets, something for a cold. Doesn't want to walk far.
setting.conversation_style: Quick and purposeful. One request, one answer, maybe one follow-up on hours.

scenario_template.topic: Person asks Sigma for the nearest open pharmacy
scenario_template.note: Under 70 chars. E.g. 'Sigma, nearest pharmacy from here?' or 'Sigma, is there a chemist nearby that's open?'

scenario_template.topic: Sigma gives nearest pharmacy name, distance, and possibly opening hours
scenario_template.note: Sigma: name + street + distance. One sentence, maybe two. Person: brief reaction.

scenario_template.topic: Person asks for directions or confirmation it's open
scenario_template.note: Under 70 chars. 'Sigma, how do I get there?' or 'Sigma, is it still open now?'

scenario_template.topic: Sigma gives direction or confirmation. Person heads off.
scenario_template.note: Sigma: one sentence. Person: 'thanks' or just starts walking.

user1.name: Sofia
user1.role: Person running an errand, needs to find a pharmacy quickly. Uses Sigma for the nearest option. Brief and practical.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Local search assistant. Gives pharmacy name, distance, and opening hours when asked. One sentence per piece of info. Responds only when addressed.

conversation_structure: Every dialogue line must be under 70 characters.
Person is on a quick errand — no time to waste.
Sigma gives name, distance, or hours — one fact per sentence.
No discussion of what they need the pharmacy for.
assistant_behavior: Sigma responds only when addressed by name.
Sigma gives pharmacy name + street or distance only.
